rules.sentence: In ITP, antiplatelet autoantibodies attach to platelets and megakaryocytes, enhancing platelet destruction and reducing production.
These antibodies can arise in primary ITP, drug-induced ITP, lymphoproliferative disorders, autoimmune diseases (eg, SLE), and chronic infections, including hepatitis C, HIV, and Helicobacter pylori.
Extensive fluid resuscitation or blood transfusion can lead to dilutional thrombocytopenia.
Increased plasma volume during pregnancy contributes to dilutional effects, representing one of several mechanisms underlying gestational thrombocytopenia.[24][25]
